infobox.usage: Unlocks Shatun's hideout inside a house in the eastern village on Woods.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Shatun's hideout key (Shatun) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key that unlocks a door to one of the village houses located somewhere in Priozersk natural reserve. Belonged to one of the Arena gladiators by the name "Shatun".

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text: - Can only be bartered from Ref LL1

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Shatun's hideout inside a house in the eastern village on Woods.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Yellow keycard spawn location
- Loose loot (Valuables, Weapon mods, Electronics)
- 1x Sports bag
- Possible Springfield Armory M1A 7.62x51 rifle (variant 2k18 NY)
- Possible modified Springfield Armory M1A 7.62x51 rifle
- Possible standard or modified Remington R11 RSASS 7.62x51 marksman rifle
- Possible Walker's XCEL 500BT Digital headset
- Possible Peltor ComTac IV Hybrid headset (Coyote Brown)
- Possible LBT-6094A Slick Plate Carrier (Black)
- Possible LBT-6094A Slick Plate Carrier (Olive Drab)
- Possible LBT-6094A Slick Plate Carrier (Coyote Tan)
- Possible 5.11 Tactical Hexgrid plate carrier
- Possible BNTI Gzhel-K body armor
